headline: 29 NHS trusts not using Palantir AI despite NHS benefit claims
summary: NHS England credits 29 hospital trusts with benefiting from Palantir's AI-powered medical data platform, but the trusts say they are using little or none of it. Watchdog group Medact flagged the 29 disputed entries, and a senior health official called the gap between NHS claims and trusts' own comments 'very misleading'. The dispute surfaces as ministers weigh the future of a £330 million Palantir deal.
